topic: accept all tracked changes in a Word document at once
core_question: How do I approve every tracked edit in a Word document in one step? (secondary: How do I keep slugs from eating my hostas?)
answer_summary: On the Review tab, click the Accept dropdown and choose 'Accept All Changes' (or 'Accept All and Stop Tracking') to finalize every edit.; after the topic shift: Ring the plants with diatomaceous earth (or set shallow beer traps nearby) to kill or trap slugs before they reach the leaves.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; texting quickly with typos here and there
